name: Fireworks AI
summary: AI inference and model customization platform. Interview preparation covers Applied ML, ML infrastructure, and clearly labeled general coding reports.

interview_process.summary: Reports vary across Applied MLE, ML Infra, Research, and General SWE. They do not establish a universal loop.

stages.name: Applied MLE onsite coding
stages.signal: A candidate described AI-assisted graph recommendations with bounded scoring. The exact scoring formula is unspecified.

stages.name: ML infrastructure system design
stages.signal: A candidate described multi-model LLM serving, weight updates, load balancing, reliability, and scaling.

stages.name: General coding context
stages.signal: Other reports cover log attack detection and GPU idle intervals. These are General SWE/SDE evidence; applicability to Research is unconfirmed.

stages.name: Applied ML and Field Engineering take-homes
stages.signal: Public candidate submissions describe financial SQL plus filing RAG and an interactive text-to-SQL CLI. These are candidate-published assignment artifacts; independent interview-event counts are unresolved.

sources.label: Mike candidate submission and original-brief section

notes.label: Research / post-training evidence
notes.detail: No sufficiently specified, independently verified post-training question was found in this collection. Official roles establish relevance, not interview questions.

notes.label: Public-source expansion
notes.detail: The two take-home families were cross-checked across multiple GitHub submissions. They use the written coding workspace with local execution/evaluation, and their unverified interview-event frequency remains uncounted.
